node.title: Re^2: Replace value in the text file
node.author: afoken
node.doctext:
I understand Marshall and Huck solution, but not sure tybalt89 solution.

Don't worry, tybalt89 has the nasty habbit of posting completely uncommented, unexplained code that may or may not work; sometimes it works only accidentally.

Your best bet for handling CSV data is to use [mod://Text::CSV_XS], its slower pure-perl implementation [mod://Text::CSV], or [mod://DBI] in combination with [mod://DBD::CSV]. The latter pair uses Text::CSV_XS behind the scenes to provide an SQL interface to the data in CSV files.

Alexander

--
Today I will gladly share my knowledge and experience, for there are no sweeter words than "I told you so". ;-)
